name: India Cements Ltd
title: India Cements Ltd - 530005 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Document is UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call, not India Cements' own call; India Cements' EBITDA/t reached INR497 in Q4 with INR1,000 target by FY28, while sector pricing rose ~2.5% and bag costs hit INR90 crore in March.

utilisation.quote: we have operated at 90% capacity utilization across our network

capex.quote: We see a plan of investing around INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores every year for the foreseeable future.

triggers.label: Grey cement pricing up ~2.5%
triggers.quote: grey cement pricing strengthened about 2.5% in most geographies

triggers.label: Utilisation ~90% across network
triggers.quote: we have operated at 90% capacity utilization across our network

triggers.label: Cement price hike taken in April
triggers.quote: We have taken price increases for cement in the month of April.

triggers.label: Brand-transition cost drag, bag costs INR90 cr
triggers.quote: our incremental cost on bags was approximately INR 90 crores

guidance.value: over INR1,000 per ton by end FY28
guidance.quote: this definitely is going to take us over INR1,000 per ton, as committed by the end of fiscal '28
We expect a sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum.
1.54x is our target to reach by fiscal '28.

guidance.value: higher than INR300 per ton by FY28
guidance.quote: we will deliver higher than INR300 by fiscal '28.

red_flags.label: Fuel/diesel cost risk into July-September
red_flags.quote: July, September would be some ripples that you will see

evasions.topic: Industry price-hike pushback / cement pricing vs peers
evasions.quote: Fragmentation of the industry is as sweet and small answer, Pinakin
This is as high it can get. So I don't know what's your question.
Once we are convinced that there is no risk to us. We could look at the next phase of integration.
